profit_quality.assessment: 2024 operating cash flow was strong at RMB367.427m, but reported profit was distorted by RMB159.571m of ECL impairment and the entertainment/film business remains a drag. Education is cash generative because tuition is prepaid, yet cash distributability is limited by PRC VIE/school structure, prepaid service obligations and school development fund rules.
adjustments: Started from recurring cash generation rather than reported parent net profit because 2023-2024 impairments are large non-cash items.
Used 2024 OCF of RMB367.427m, less RMB107.603m of actual property/equipment and intangible capex, then reserved RMB30m for normalized working-capital reinvestment.
Used RMB220m as pre-haircut distributable cash profit and applied a 0.65 cash-profit haircut for VIE/school extraction limits, mixed business quality and receivable/film impairment history.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: OCF was RMB339.842m in 2022, RMB373.895m in 2023 and RMB367.427m in 2024; actual capex was about RMB107.803m, RMB298.897m and RMB107.603m respectively.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable education OCF supports the numerator, but cash is not cleanly distributable to the Hong Kong listed parent and the entertainment receivable clean-up still affects sustainable quality.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported parent net profit was only RMB92.064m in 2024, while OCF was RMB367.427m because non-cash impairment and prepaid tuition dominate the bridge.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No disclosed maintenance/growth split; 2024 capex of RMB107.603m is used as the maintenance proxy, while 2023 capex was much higher at RMB298.897m.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working-capital movement included RMB24.579m trade/other receivable increase and RMB8.533m contract liability increase; a RMB30m normalized reinvestment reserve is used.
